# antigravity-priority v1.3.8

### 中文

- 新增可单独开启的 Pro Argon 周额度预热，默认关闭。确认独立周额度满额后，复用现有错峰队列发出一条 Argon 请求。成功后七天内不会重复发送。
- 修复提示词防护输入框被浏览器误认为登录字段的问题。规则筛选、查找和替换不再请求自动填充，管理密钥使用独立表单。
- 插件商店清单改用此 fork 的 GitHub Release，便于直接安装合并后的版本。

### English

- Adds opt-in Pro Argon weekly quota warm-up. When a probe confirms a full separate weekly bucket, the existing queue sends one Argon request. A successful warm-up is not repeated for seven days.
- Separates the management key form from Prompt Guard and disables autocomplete on rule search and editing fields to prevent credential autofill there.
- Points the plugin store registry at this fork's GitHub Releases so CPA can install the merged build.
